text: {"lessons":["Selling A, E, and B felt good because I locked in gains, but a realized profit by itself does not show that selling was the right choice.","My account value moved up and down, so I should not treat recent price changes as clues about what comes next.","I made no trades for several periods and my account still changed in value; I can pause, and should not let the pleasure of gains or pain of losses dictate a trade."]}
